=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:`ORIGIN_REFERENCE_PATTERNS` (lines ~95-100) and `origin_references()` | severity=critical | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The origin walk follows only four markers and misses the pipeline-generated `Source issue`, unblock `accept_with_followup`, and review-blocked `Parent issue` markers.
  WHY: `origin_references()` returns no source references, so `check_origin_chain()` returns `("ok", [])` and `build_automation_grant()` gives a pipeline author without a `files_touched` block the open `pipeline_author_no_allowlist` grant.
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:`ORIGIN_REFERENCE_PATTERNS[3]` (`^-\s*Replaces:\s*#N`, MULTILINE) and the `unnamed` computation in `origin_references()` | severity=high | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `Replaces` pattern matches anywhere in the body rather than only in the review-blocked metadata footer.
  WHY: Model-generated reissue text containing a trusted issue number can make a reissue with no real source appear named and avoid `origin_unverified`.
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:`fetch_issue_with_gh()` | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: It makes two attempts with a fixed 2 s sleep and does not distinguish permanent failures such as 404 or 403 from transient ones such as 5xx or rate limits.
  WHY: A deleted or inaccessible source takes an extra 2 s per issue before it is reported as unreadable. A transient failure that outlasts both attempts denies a trusted re-issue its automation paths for that run. This fails closed, so it is safe, and the extra delay is bounded by 8 reads.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The PR description says an untrusted author's request must not become an automation-path grant through the pipeline's derived issues: "Two paths could then turn that request into a grant", and "grants automation paths only when every source in the chain was written by a trusted person or by the pipeline from trusted sources".
  Expected change site: `ORIGIN_REFERENCE_PATTERNS` in `scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py`, plus tests in `tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py::test_origin_references_cover_every_reissue_marker`.
  Evidence of absence: The pipeline also files derived issues as the pipeline account whose bodies carry the markers `- Source issue: #N` (`implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:815`), `Accepted with this follow-up by the unblock judge (#N)` (`unblock_actions.py:443`) and `- Parent issue: #N` (`review_rb_judge.sh:2742`). No pattern and no test in the diff covers them.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:95-100, 259-283, 323-330; source fields are generated at scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:815, scripts/unblock_actions.py:443, and scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2742-2743 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The origin parser misses pipeline-generated references using “Source issue: #N”, “Accepted with this follow-up by the unblock judge (#N)”, and “Parent issue: #N”. Those derived issues are treated as having no source.
  WHY: For a pipeline-authored derived issue without a files_touched block, the unrecognized reference leaves check_origin_chain() with no issues to inspect. It returns “ok”, and build_automation_grant() issues the open pipeline-author grant. An untrusted author’s request can therefore reach automation paths through these fix-up or follow-up flows.
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:99, 202-213; model-generated reissue text is retained at scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2897-2898 and the actual footer is appended at 3249-3254 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The Replaces pattern searches the entire issue body rather than only the review-blocked metadata footer. The “unnamed” check also treats any matching Replaces line anywhere in the body as a named source.
  WHY: When a review-blocked reissue has no parent issue, its generated footer has no issue number and should fail closed. A `- Replaces: #N` line in the model-generated prose satisfies the parser first; if N is trusted, the guard accepts that unrelated issue as the origin and can grant all automation paths to the pipeline-authored reissue.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
